brief: Two-storey Italianate/Renaissance Revival city hall (modelled on a county courthouse; the county seat is Harrow Falls) in red brick on a limestone base, set on a raised lawn inside a low stone wall: a central pedimented pavilion with a one-storey columned entrance porch, round-arched windows with white keystoned hoods throughout, white pilasters with foliate capitals and a bracketed cornice, a hipped slate roof with small corner turrets/chimney stacks, and a tall white two-stage clock tower with arched belfry openings and a domed cap rising from the centre. Wide stone steps, lamp posts, big shade trees.
